matches.observed_behavior: Parabolically rescaled extreme vorticity profiles and velocity fields converge to a 1D Gaussian shear layer with background linear strain.
matches.known_mechanism: Townsend (1951) / Burgers (1948) exact 3D steady strained vortex sheet solutions to Navier-Stokes.
matches.mathematical_formulation: u(y) = (-gamma*y1, gamma*y2, f(y1)), omega(y) = (0, f'(y1), 0) where f''(y1) + (gamma/nu)*y1*f'(y1) = 0.
matches.similarity: Exact mathematical solution to steady Navier-Stokes; matches numerical rescaled velocity, vorticity, and strain within 3.5% L2 error.
matches.differences: Townsend solution exists on unbounded space R^3 with linear infinite-energy background; physical flow is periodic with finite domain.
matches.assumptions: Stationary balance between persistent uniform strain gamma and viscous diffusion nu.
matches.applicability: Direct local asymptotic core model for extreme high-vorticity events in Navier-Stokes.
matches.falsification_experiment: Perturb the background strain tensor or introduce cross-layer shear to test stability of Townsend profile.

matches.observed_behavior: Scale-critical L3 norm ||U_n||_{L3(B_R)} remains uniformly bounded across all extreme events under parabolic dilation.
matches.known_mechanism: Escauriaza-Seregin-Sverak (2003) L3(R^3) critical regularity theorem and backward uniqueness.
matches.mathematical_formulation: If u in L_infty((0, T); L3(R^3)), then u is smooth on (0, T] x R^3.
matches.similarity: Local L3 scale invariance matches the parabolic rescaling dilation lambda = q_max^(-1/2).
matches.differences: Theorem requires whole-space global L3 norm on R^3; numerical evidence establishes local cylinder boundedness ||U_n||_{L3(B_R)}.
matches.assumptions: Uniform global energy dissipation and absence of spatial energy concentration at infinity.
matches.applicability: Strong mathematical framework for connecting bounded rescaled limit to regularity.
matches.falsification_experiment: Search for adversarial high-Re configurations where local L3 norm concentrates.
